name: INUMI's setMarketingWallet is unprotected and rescueEth pays the marketing wallet
summary: The unverified INUMI token lets any caller run setMarketingWallet(address), and rescueEth() sends the contract's whole ETH balance to the marketing wallet. One block after the deployer created the token with 5 ETH, a bot contract set itself as marketing wallet and called rescueEth for the 5 ETH; a second bot took the 2 ETH the deployer sent next the same way.
notes: Campaign: the token's only ETH outflows are the anchor and the second bot's call one block after the deployer's 2 ETH top-up; the token had no other transactions. Both bot senders are long-running MEV accounts unrelated to the Binance-funded deployer.
